1.

Glory, Lord, we give to Thee, Thou art our Redeemer; God our debt on Thee hath laid, Ransom full for us Thou hast brought.

2.

All Thy work completed is, Thou to the Father joy dost render; He from death did bring Thee forth, Gave Thee life eternal.

3.

At His side Thou sittest now, Dost in patience wait there still, Makest intercession good for us with God, Till Thou dost fetch home Thy bride.

4.

Soon Thou shalt come again, Take us to the Father’s home. We Thy coming surely wait; Amen, come, O Jesus Christ!
